name: Goan Chicken Vindaloo Pizza
cooking_method: Braise chicken in vindaloo sauce, drain, top and bake

portion.construction: braised vindaloo chicken, dry-ish, on mozzarella

steps: Braise chicken in vindaloo sauce to 74 °C, shred or chop, reduce until nearly dry.
Top the stretched dough, bake hot; finish with onion, chile, cilantro and raita-crema.

critical_parameters.topping: must be dry (menu matrix: 'dry shred only')

plating: Whole pizza on a board, crema in lines.
food_safety: Poultry to 74 °C; cool braise per two-stage rule; reheat to 74 °C if re-heated for hot holding.
NO PORK: traditional vindaloo is often pork; NASHA recipe is chicken only (D-54).
